top_stories.title: Okta Launches Agent SSO to Standardize Digital Labor Identity
top_stories.summary: Okta announced the general availability of Agent SSO on August 24, 2026, a product designed to manage AI agent identities distinctly from traditional service accounts. The solution registers AI agents as first-class identity principals, standardizing how enterprises handle authentication and authorization for digital labor workforces.

top_stories.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage causes auth issues, service failures
top_stories.summary: Microsoft experienced a massive Microsoft 365 outage causing authentication failures and service disruptions for Exchange Online customers. The incident affected auth systems and prompted an active investigation by Microsoft.

top_stories.title: GM’s 200,000-user passkey rollout exposes the hard parts admins miss
top_stories.summary: General Motors deployed passkeys to approximately 200,000 employees using FIDO2 authentication, revealing that the primary challenge lies in eliminating legacy weak-method authentication dependencies rather than enabling the technology itself. The rollout uses Microsoft Entra ID, which is set to make passkeys the default authentication method starting September 1.

top_stories.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Flaw Following Disclosure
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Attackers are actively exploiting the flaw following its public disclosure.

top_stories.title: Attackers Exploit Critical JFrog Artifactory Flaw to Mint Admin Tokens Days After Disclosure
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329, CVSS 9.8) in JFrog Artifactory is being actively exploited days after public disclosure, allowing attackers to gain administrative access. The flaw involves an authentication weakness present under default configurations, enabling threat actors to mint admin tokens without valid credentials.

news.title: Vali Cyber ZeroLock 5 brings MFA to the hypervisor command line
news.summary: Vali Cyber released ZeroLock 5, a security product that adds MFA to the hypervisor command line for ESX and Linux hosts. The release targets insider threats and stolen credentials at the hypervisor layer, addressing authentication gaps in virtualization infrastructure.

news.title: Open-source secrets scanning tool Sift hunts credentials in Microsoft 365, Slack, and Jira
news.summary: Stratus Security released Sift, a free open-source command line tool designed to scan for exposed credentials, API keys, and passwords across enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, SharePoint, Slack, and Jira. The tool was originally built for penetration testing engagements and searches both local and cloud-based storage locations where sensitive credentials may be inadvertently stored.

news.title: Nearly 22,000 Microsoft Exchange servers vulnerable to hijack attacks
news.summary: Nearly 22,000 Microsoft Exchange servers remain unpatched against a high-severity authentication bypass vulnerability that enables attackers to hijack all user mailboxes. The flaw allows unauthorized access without valid credentials, representing a significant authentication and access control failure in a widely deployed enterprise email platform.

news.title: Threat Actors Don’t Want Better Attacks. They Want Repeatable Ones
news.summary: Microsoft's threat intelligence team identified ClickFix as the most common initial access method observed last year, a social engineering technique that manipulates users into executing malicious commands by exploiting clipboard and terminal interactions. The trend highlights how attackers are increasingly bypassing technical security controls by targeting human behavior and authentication entry points rather than exploiting software vulnerabilities.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, with the FBI's New Orleans field office launching a formal investigation. The images appear to have been sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company, representing a major breach of identity verification infrastructure.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealer malware to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Anthropic Claude user accounts. The attack targeted session credentials rather than passwords, bypassing standard authentication controls to hijack active user sessions.

news.title: Securing Claude Code: The New Compliance API, Local Visibility, and Identity Governance
news.summary: Anthropic has introduced new Compliance API endpoints for Claude Code that provide security teams visibility into AI agent activity, including file access, shell commands, and MCP tool invocations. The article addresses identity governance challenges around AI agents, specifically whether logged access reflects legitimately provisioned credentials and permissions.

news.title: China-Linked Fire Ant Hijacks Cisco Routers to Steal Credentials and Blind Security Logs
news.summary: The China-linked threat group Fire Ant has expanded its espionage campaign to compromise Cisco IOS XR routers, TACACS servers, and Linux management hosts to steal credentials and evade security logging. The group specifically targeted TACACS authentication infrastructure, allowing them to harvest credentials from network authentication systems used in high-value enterprise environments.

news.title: Rogue agents are forcing a governance reckoning as enterprises hand over the keys
news.summary: Enterprises are facing identity governance challenges as autonomous AI agents take on mission-critical roles, requiring new access control frameworks beyond those designed for human users. The shift is prompting a reassessment of PAM, authorization, and identity governance practices to account for non-human identities operating with elevated privileges.

news.title: Automate IAM Identity Center governance with continuous discovery and reporting
news.summary: AWS has published guidance on automating IAM Identity Center governance through continuous discovery and reporting. The solution focuses on centralized authentication and authorization management for AWS resources across AWS Organizations, integrating with external identity providers.

news.title: Okta Stock Could Have More Upside After Its 28% Rally, Analysts Say
news.summary: Okta's stock has risen 28% in five days and approximately 93% year-to-date following a stronger-than-expected fiscal second-quarter earnings report. Analysts are evaluating potential further upside for the identity management vendor's shares.

news.title: File servers are here to stay. Here’s how to manage them securely
news.summary: tenfold Software published a guide outlining five best practices for secure file server access management, focusing on least-privilege access principles. The article addresses permission management complexity in IT environments where file servers remain in active use.

news.title: Article: Eliminating Long-Lived Credentials in GCP with Workload Identity Federation
news.summary: This article details the implementation of Workload Identity Federation across 120+ GCP production projects to eliminate long-lived service account credentials. The approach addresses machine identity management challenges including credential rotation, secret sprawl, and leakage risks inherent to static service account keys.

news.title: AI agents that pass authentication can still drift, expose data, or get memory-poisoned
news.summary: The article examines security risks specific to AI agents that persist even after successfully passing authentication, including behavioral drift, data exposure, and memory poisoning attacks. These risks highlight gaps in traditional authentication and authorization models when applied to non-human AI agent identities.

news.title: Huntoso – Eliminate standing access with zero-trust PAM on Entra ID
news.summary: Huntoso has introduced a Privileged Access Management (PAM) solution built on Microsoft Entra ID that implements zero-trust principles by eliminating standing access. The product targets organizations seeking just-in-time access controls integrated directly with Entra ID.

news.title: Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results with revenue rising 11% year over year to $805 million. Remaining Performance Obligations grew 17%, suggesting a potential acceleration in bookings for the IAM vendor.

news.title: Okta (OKTA) Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results showing 11% year-over-year revenue growth and 17% growth in remaining performance obligations. The results indicate a potential bookings recovery for the identity management vendor.

news.title: Okta Just Jumped 29%. AI Agents May Be Creating a New Bottleneck
news.summary: Okta's stock jumped 28.6% on August 27, closing at $172.91 after reporting better-than-expected quarterly earnings and reaching a four-year high. The article frames AI agents as a potential new growth driver for Okta's identity platform, suggesting autonomous agents create new identity and access management demands.

news.title: Key Reasons Why Identity Fabric Matters in 2026
news.summary: The article explains the concept of Identity Fabric as an architectural approach that unifies fragmented identity systems across applications, APIs, and infrastructure. It covers the architecture, risks of unmanaged identities, and runtime visibility as enterprise access expands across cloud services and automated workloads.

news.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
news.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" enables adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) attacks targeting Microsoft 365 session cookies for $320 per month. The service bypasses MFA by stealing authenticated session tokens rather than credentials, undermining standard authentication controls.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Connor Riley Moucka, a 26-year-old Canadian man, pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions targeting Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records including call and text history.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection and response processes relevant to IAM and PAM practitioners.
